summary: IDS feed s062_single is degraded due to 28.9% duplicate packets (864 of 2989, threshold 5%). All other checks (one-way, truncated, drops, overload, encrypted_share, missing_vlan, tunnel, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding the same packet twice - classic SPAN/TAP aggregation duplication. Likely both sides of a link or multiple SPANs aggregated to single IDS port without deduplication, resulting in 28.9% duplicates.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires full payload and both directions for stateful signature matching. Duplicates waste IDS CPU/capacity on redundant inspection, inflates flow/alert counts, can cause state-table issues and mask true attacks, reducing detection coverage and increasing false positives.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication on feed s062_single to drop identical packets seen within a short window before delivery to the 1G IDS port. Eliminates 28.9% waste without losing unique traffic.
